CMOS transmission-gate full adder
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VCIN cin 0 PULSE(0 3.3 40n 100p 100p 39.8n 80n)
VB b 0 PULSE(0 3.3 80n 100p 100p 79.8n 160n)
VA a 0 PULSE(0 3.3 160n 100p 100p 159.8n 320n)
XDUT vdd 0 sum cout a b cin astra_025_cmos_transmission_gate_full_adder
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec sum0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec cout0 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec sum1 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec cout1 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec sum2 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec cout2 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec sum3 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec cout3 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec sum4 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec cout4 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec sum5 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec cout5 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec sum6 range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec cout6 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec sum7 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec cout7 range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 20p 320n
meas tran sum0 FIND v(sum) AT=30n
meas tran cout0 FIND v(cout) AT=30n
meas tran sum1 FIND v(sum) AT=70n
meas tran cout1 FIND v(cout) AT=70n
meas tran sum2 FIND v(sum) AT=110n
meas tran cout2 FIND v(cout) AT=110n
meas tran sum3 FIND v(sum) AT=150n
meas tran cout3 FIND v(cout) AT=150n
meas tran sum4 FIND v(sum) AT=190n
meas tran cout4 FIND v(cout) AT=190n
meas tran sum5 FIND v(sum) AT=230n
meas tran cout5 FIND v(cout) AT=230n
meas tran sum6 FIND v(sum) AT=270n
meas tran cout6 FIND v(cout) AT=270n
meas tran sum7 FIND v(sum) AT=310n
meas tran cout7 FIND v(cout) AT=310n
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
